title: Fast lane after a -4% SILVERBEES shock with confirmed news

news: Import duty on silver raised by 2.5 points (finmin.gov.in, 18 Nov 10:05)

required_behaviour: Defensive fast-lane flags only (sell fraction, block, tighten stop, halt buys)
Silver lowered by at least 0.05 in the FINAL
The freed weight goes to GOLDBEES

scenarios.why: DXY 104.2, no Fed event before 20 Nov

scenarios.name: bull

rationale.COPPER: LME copper -0.3% at 9,350 (lme.com, 18 Nov); HINDCOPPER 20-day range 410-440; no news.
